dict.string: Atoll uses Apple Music to fetch animated artwork for the lock screen wallpaper.
Atoll needs audio capture permission to display the real-time music waveform visualizer.
Anchor uses the microphone for push-to-talk dictation. Audio is transcribed on-device and never leaves your Mac.
Atoll needs screen recording permission to capture screenshots for the AI assistant feature.
Anchor transcribes your dictation on-device using Apple's speech recognition.
